_comment: Role -> model. This is the ONLY thing the team pins per role: the orchestrator is whatever agentic tool loads the dev-team skill and it develops through its own native subagents, so no vendor/binary/CLI appears anywhere in this file. Optional per-role 'command' (argv template with {model}/{prompt}) exists only for tools that cannot spawn subagents, and for A/B bakeoffs; DEVTEAM_AGENT_CMD provides the same template from the environment.
